column1: # INDEX.tsv — one row per preserved pinned8 archive. Generated once from the files
# beside it and then frozen, for the same reason free-placement/INDEX.tsv is: see
# README.md. The command that generated it is in the commit that landed this set.
# Membership is the MEASURED predicate "carries a keel-pin: line", not the revision
# and not the name: an archive is in this era because the instrument that produced it
# recorded the mask it ran under. `kind` is likewise read from which benchmarks the
# file contains, since the name does not say.
#   1 file       the archive beside this index
#   2 rev        the tree revision, from the name (bench_csv put it there)
#   3 host       the hostname, from the name; `—` where bench_csv was called untagged
#   4 cpu_model  keel-bench-cpu, the exact string the registries key on
#   6 gomaxprocs keel-bench-gomaxprocs — the mask holds this to 8
#   7 kind       ladder (judged benchmarks + ceiling arm) | clock-window
#  10 pin_mask   keel-pin, the affinity mask the run actually applied (§5 rule 5)
